upload.title: Amazon's "AI" Store Had a Secret 👀 #shorts
upload.description: Just Walk Out lets you grab items and leave: ceiling cameras and shelf weight sensors decide what you took and bill you. In 2024 a report by The Information claimed about 1,000 workers in India reviewed shopping trips and that in 2022 roughly 700 of every 1,000 sales needed human review; Amazon called that untrue and said the team mainly labels data to train the AI. In January 2026 Amazon announced it was closing every Amazon Go store, but the tech now runs in about 360 third-party locations, from stadiums to hospitals.
